chunks: Whoever takes an oath and says, 'No, by the Lord of the Mushaf,' then upon him is a single expiation.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.رَبِّ الْمُصْحَفِ: the Lord of the Mushaf, meaning Allah as invoked in the oath

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on swearing an oath by saying, 'No, by the Lord of the Mushaf'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding an oath sworn by saying, "No, by the Lord of the Mushaf." It indicates that such an oath entails one expiation, placing it within the jurisprudence of oaths and kaffarah.
